# topozarr reference metadata

Root group attributes written by [topozarr](https://github.com/carbonplan/topozarr) 0.1.9
(commit d661b5a) for the cases in `generate.py`. They are compared against the metadata
written with `CellCenterStyle()`.

Regenerate with:

```sh
uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with topozarr==0.1.9 python generate.py .
```
